name: Eddy's Kitchen
signature_dish: Wak Bibik Bika Song•tata + Nakam We•tepa
must_try: matchu tangsek pura (beef with crushed rice)
why_it_matters: First Tura restaurant exclusively dedicated to authentic Garo traditional cuisine, opened October 2025 by chef-owner Eddy D Marak. Slow-cooked tribal recipes (Wak Bibik, Na•kam, Brenga smoke-cures) made with locally sourced ingredients — the closest thing Tura has to a 'Garo cuisine specialist' restaurant.
insider_tip: Slow-cooked Wak Brenga and We•sroma need pre-ordering — call 9863847392 / 6909455684 a few hours ahead. Open daily for lunch and dinner.
signature_address: Rongkhon, near Derangitim, Tura, West Garo Hills, Meghalaya 794101

name: Brenga Restaurant (Hotel Rikman Continental)
why_it_matters: The dining room of Hotel Rikman Continental — Tura's most-listed full-service hotel — and one of the few places in town that will plate authentic Garo cuisine alongside standard Indian/Chinese fare for non-residents. Named after the Garo smoke-cure technique 'brenga'.
insider_tip: Authentic Garo dishes (wak pura, kappa, nakam) need advance notice — request when booking. Walking distance from Tura bus stand and helipad.
signature_address: Hotel Rikman Continental, Tura Circular Road / Tura Bazaar, West Garo Hills, Tura, Meghalaya 794001
